newsitem.title: USA: Famous Dave's to redeem class A warrants.
newsitem.headline: Famous Dave's to redeem class A warrants.

text.p: Famous Dave's of America Inc said Wednesday it has called for redemption all issued class A warrants issued as part of its initial public offering in October 1996.

The company said warrant holders have 30 days to exercise the warrants before they are redeemed on July 28. Each of the 2,645,000 warrants entitles the holder to purchase one share of company common stock at $8.50 per share.
The company said it has had to right to redeem the warrants at $0.01 per share since mid-May, when the average closing price of its stock exceeded $10.20 per share for 10 consecutive trading days.
The company said the estimated $22 million that will be generated by the exercise of warrants will finance national expansion of the barbeque restaurant chain.
